findings.description: Target membership, scaffold and inherited Team source need owner precedence; D69 shared with RoleAssignment/Role/Team does not merge identities.

Singular membership Person/Team/attribution and meaningful record/endpoint separation need actual carrier/PersonReference/Human/Team/common-carrier maps. Multiple memberships per pair allowed absent reviewed uniqueness policy.

Time-bounded source versus active carrier with null end: finite-ended versus effective-period interpretation unresolved. Clock/order/endpoint inclusivity/calendar/currentness need explicit policies; current is not just active.
Independent proposed/active/inactive/revoked state, basis/owner, operation/termination/correction/succession/challenge/history need exact governed policy and unbounded preservation/liveness evidence.
Team identity is not its current member set; stable purpose/scope/owner allowed changes and active current-member/proposed empty-Team cases require exact inherited-source scope and runtime proof.

Membership/currentness/records do not entail role/responsibility/ownership/authority/permission/employment/consent/identity verification/private facts/admission/effects. Independent evidence/decisions may establish them.
Twenty-one declared uses need independent complete edge/common-carrier review; field projections are not actual Kind relations. Selected local D69 bytes do not authenticate live producer currentness.
